The structure of Er20Hg4Sb16 (reduced formula Er5HgSb4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 38), with 40 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Er centers with 10 neighbors (Er, Hg, Sb), while Hg adopts 9- and 8-neighbor environments and Sb centers show 10- and 11-neighbor coordination. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Er 10-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Er 10-vertex and Sb 11-vertex polyhedra.
